raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":489,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT ROUND(((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100, 2) AS tax_to_net_profit_ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON r.company_id = f.company_id AND YEAR(f.report_date) = r.tax_year WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰速运' AND r.tax_year = 2025;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"计算顺丰速运2025年度所得税费用","tables":["MYSQL:finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns","MYSQL:finance_tax.companies"],"columns":["revenue","non_taxable_income","deductions","prior_year_losses","is_key_high_tech","employee_count","total_assets","is_restricted_industry"]},{"requirement":"计算顺丰速运2025年度净利润","tables":["MYSQL:finance_tax.company_financials"],"columns":["total_assets","total_liabilities","report_date"]},{"requirement":"筛选顺丰速运","tables":["MYSQL:finance_tax.stocks"],"columns":["stock_name","company_id"]},{"requirement":"计算所得税费用占净利润的比例","tables":[],"columns":[]}],"assumptions":["净利润采用知识库定义：总资产减总负债（company_financials表）","所得税费用采用知识库定义：应纳税所得额乘以适用税率，税率根据高新技术企业15%、小型微利企业20%、其他25%判定","顺丰速运对应stocks.stock_name字段值"]}
